posts.title: How effective is molar distalisation with aligners?
posts.description: Over the past year, we have reviewed several papers measuring the effectiveness of clear aligners. Most of these have concluded that there is a discrepancy between predicted and actual tooth movement. This new paper is by an established USA-based team and explores the effects of Invisalign on distal movement of maxillary molars. posts.title: MARPE with Custom 3D‑appliance has high success, low complications
posts.description: Adult maxillary expansion is an important area of orthodontics. For years, we believed surgically assisted expansion was necessary for most adults with a significant transverse maxillary discrepancy.
